question: Find the name and number of citations of the author who has most citations among all authors?

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "authorships" AS SELECT CAST(paper_id AS TEXT) AS paper_id, CAST(author_id AS TEXT) AS author_id FROM table_2

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH author_papers AS (
    SELECT a.author_id::TEXT AS author_id, a.name AS author_name, ap.paper_id AS paper_id
    FROM authors a
    JOIN authorships ap
      ON a.author_id::TEXT = ap.author_id::TEXT
),
paper_citation_counts AS (
    SELECT cited_paper_id AS paper_id, COUNT(*) AS citations
    FROM citations
    GROUP BY cited_paper_id
),
author_citations AS (
    SELECT ap.author_id, ap.author_name, COALESCE(SUM(pcc.citations), 0) AS total_citations
    FROM author_papers ap

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH 
-- Ensure author_id is text consistently
authors_norm AS (
  SELECT CAST(author_id AS TEXT) AS author_id, name AS author_name
  FROM authors
),
authorships_norm AS (
  SELECT paper_id, CAST(author_id AS TEXT) AS author_id
  FROM authorships
),
-- Some datasets store multiple cited paper ids comma-separated in cited_paper_id; split if needed
citations_expanded AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(cpid) AS cited_paper_id, 
    TRIM(paper_id) AS paper_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      /* if cited_paper_id contains commas, split; else keep as-is */
      UNNEST(
        CASE 
          WHEN POSITION(',' IN cited_paper_id) > 0 THEN STRING_SPLIT(cited_paper_id, ',')
          ELSE [cited_paper_id]
        END
      ) AS cpid,
      paper_id
    FROM citations
  )
),
-- Count citations received per paper
paper_citation_counts AS (
  SELECT cited_paper_id AS paper_id, COUNT(*) AS citations
  FROM citations_expanded
  WHERE cited_paper_id IS NOT NULL AND cited_paper_id <> ''
  GROUP BY cited_paper_id
),
-- Map authors to their papers
author_papers AS (
  SELECT a.author_id, a.author_name, an.paper_id
  FROM authors_norm a
  JOIN authorships_norm an
    ON a.author_id = an.author_id
),
-- Sum citations over each author's papers
author_citations AS (
  SELECT ap.author_name AS author, COALESCE(SUM(pcc.citations), 0) AS citations
  FROM author_papers ap
  LEFT JOIN paper_citation_counts pcc
    ON ap.paper_id = pcc.paper_id
  GROUP BY ap.author_name
)
SELECT author, citations
FROM author_citations
ORDER BY citations DESC, author ASC
LIMIT 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH 
  authors_norm AS (
    SELECT CAST(author_id AS TEXT) AS author_id, name AS author_name
    FROM authors
  ),
  authorships_norm AS (
    SELECT CAST(author_id AS TEXT) AS author_id, TRIM(paper_id) AS paper_id
    FROM authorships
  ),
  -- Expand citations where one row may list multiple citing paper_ids comma-separated
  citing_expanded AS (
    SELECT TRIM(cpid) AS citing_paper_id, TRIM(cited_paper_id) AS cited_paper_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        UNNEST(
          CASE WHEN POSITION(',' IN paper_id) > 0 THEN STRING_SPLIT(paper_id, ',') ELSE [paper_id] END
        ) AS cpid,
        cited_paper_id
      FROM citations
    )
    WHERE citing_paper_id IS NOT NULL AND citing_paper_id <> ''
  ),
  -- Map citing papers to their authors
  citing_authors AS (
    SELECT an.author_id, an.paper_id AS citing_paper_id
    FROM authorships_norm an
    JOIN citing_expanded ce
      ON an.paper_id = ce.citing_paper_id
  ),
  author_out_citations AS (
    SELECT ca.author_id, COUNT(*) AS citations
    FROM citing_authors ca
    GROUP BY ca.author_id
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT a.author_name AS author, ao.citations,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ao.citations DESC, a.author_name ASC) AS rn
    FROM author_out_citations ao
    JOIN authors_norm a ON a.author_id = ao.author_id
  )
SELECT author, citations
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

# Compute most citing author (outgoing citations), since no overlap between cited_paper_id and authorships paper_ids.
sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH 
  authors_norm AS (
    SELECT CAST(author_id AS TEXT) AS author_id, name AS author_name
    FROM authors
  ),
  authorships_norm AS (
    SELECT CAST(author_id AS TEXT) AS author_id, TRIM(paper_id) AS paper_id
    FROM authorships
  ),
  -- Expand citations where one row may list multiple citing paper_ids comma-separated
  citing_expanded AS (
    SELECT TRIM(cpid) AS citing_paper_id, TRIM(cited_paper_id) AS cited_paper_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        UNNEST(
          CASE WHEN POSITION(',' IN paper_id) > 0 THEN STRING_SPLIT(paper_id, ',') ELSE [paper_id] END
        ) AS cpid,
        cited_paper_id
      FROM citations
    )
    WHERE citing_paper_id IS NOT NULL AND citing_paper_id <> ''
  ),
  -- Map citing papers to their authors
  citing_authors AS (
    SELECT an.author_id, an.paper_id AS citing_paper_id
    FROM authorships_norm an
    JOIN citing_expanded ce
      ON an.paper_id = ce.citing_paper_id
  ),
  author_out_citations AS (
    SELECT ca.author_id, COUNT(*) AS citations
    FROM citing_authors ca
    GROUP BY ca.author_id
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT a.author_name AS author, ao.citations,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ao.citations DESC, a.author_name ASC) AS rn
    FROM author_out_citations ao
    JOIN authors_norm a ON a.author_id = ao.author_id
  )
SELECT author, citations
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
'''
